# Decidiq

> Decidiq is a decision-making platform for Nextcloud for governance bodies, associations, corporate boards and operational meetings: meetings, agendas, motions, voting, minutes and decision tracking. It stores its data in OpenRegister.

Start with AGENTS.md for the build, test and lint commands. All paths below are relative to the repository root.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test, lint, OpenSpec flow and conventions
- [README.md](README.md): features, installation and development
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): architecture, standards and data model
- [docs/FEATURES.md](docs/FEATURES.md): feature analysis and product strategy
- [docs/intro.md](docs/intro.md): start page of the documentation site
- [docs/features/](docs/features/): one page per feature
- [docs/Technical/board-portal-architecture.md](docs/Technical/board-portal-architecture.md): board portal architecture
- [docs/admin/board-portal-admin.md](docs/admin/board-portal-admin.md): board portal administration
- [docs/Installation/demo-environment.md](docs/Installation/demo-environment.md): the demo environment
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): contribution rules and commit format

## API

- [openapi.json](openapi.json): OpenAPI document for the app's JSON API
- [docs/api/board-portal.openapi.yaml](docs/api/board-portal.openapi.yaml): OpenAPI document for the board portal endpoints
- [appinfo/routes.php](appinfo/routes.php): route table

## Specs

- [openspec/specs/](openspec/specs/): one directory per capability, each with a spec.md of requirements and scenarios
- [openspec/changes/](openspec/changes/): open change proposals
- [openspec/architecture/](openspec/architecture/): architecture decision records
- [openspec/README.md](openspec/README.md): how the openspec folder is organised
- [openspec/config.yaml](openspec/config.yaml): rules for proposals, specs and designs
- [lib/Settings/decidesk_register.json](lib/Settings/decidesk_register.json) and [lib/Settings/register.d/](lib/Settings/register.d/): the OpenRegister schemas the app installs
